import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('data/credit_fraud.csv')

plt.figure(figsize=(12, 5))

# First subplot: transaction_type vs fraud
plt.subplot(1, 2, 1)
sns.countplot(x='transaction_type', hue='is_fraud', data=df)
plt.title('Transaction Type vs Fraud')
plt.xlabel('Transaction Type')
plt.ylabel('Count')
plt.legend(title='Is Fraud')

# Second subplot: hour_of_day vs fraud rate
plt.subplot(1, 2, 2)
fraud_rate_hour = df.groupby('hour_of_day')['is_fraud'].mean().reset_index()
fraud_rate_hour['hour'] = fraud_rate_hour['hour_of_day'].astype(str)
sns.lineplot(x='hour_of_day', y='is_fraud', data=fraud_rate_hour, marker='o')
plt.title('Fraud Rate by Hour of Day')
plt.xlabel('Hour of Day')
plt.ylabel('Fraud Proportion')
plt.xticks(range(0, 24, 2))  # Show every 2 hours for clarity

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
